command:
set -eu
unit_tmp=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$unit_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat >"$unit_tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=OS comparison inventory worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$unit_tmp" /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
printf '%s\n' '=== installed unit ==='
systemctl cat inventory-worker.service
